literal_meaning: মুখ ফুটে ওঠা (mouth blooming or opening)
figurative_meaning_en: to start speaking or uttering words
example_sentences_in_bangla: শিশুর মুখ ফুটেছে, এখন সে কথা বলতে শিখছে।
বাচ্চাটির মুখ ফোটার পর পরিবারে উৎসবের আমেজ ছড়িয়ে পড়ল।
example_sentences_in_english: The baby's mouth has opened; now she is learning to speak.
After the child began to speak, joy spread throughout the family.
note: This idiom is commonly used in Bengali culture to mark the joyful milestone of a child's first words.
